verdict.rationale: Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme is a laptop processor (CPU and NPU silicon), and user-facing data retention and deletion controls belong to software and services, not to a chip. Nothing in the evidence shows Qualcomm shipping retention or deletion controls for this product; the on-device AI positioning is a different capability and does not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
